method: Independent native-agent and root visual review of the exact three indexed projections, all 12 distance corners, all 15 state/alignment cases, the 72-pose motion sheet, exact point-source metrics, assembled reset view, and exact rear-shell phone/beam cue.
acceptance: Rabbit, fox, and owl must each read decisively without captions in the exact indexed projections and remain legible across the authored distance/alignment cases.
The fox must no longer present stalk-like ears; the owl must have a clear external beak and angular wings rather than the prior round bat-like lobes.
An assembled exact-mesh view must pair the fixed pointer with the home-V marks, and the phone-side exact mesh must visibly connect a phone-shaped opening to a widening beam aimed toward the portal.
The 5-degree cycle must be described only as an eclipse wipe, not continuous animal recognition.
Digital judgment must not be represented as human recognition, delight, first-use discovery, finite-emitter, room-light, physical-use, or durability evidence.
